error.recon_completed.en: This statement is completed, so it can't be changed. To change it, reopen it with Reopen beside it under Statements on its bank's page.

acct.recon_no_contact_named.en: No record names a contact, so none is set.

acct.err_recon_line_state.en: This line is {status} already. Undo it first, then try again.

acct.err_recon_match_needs_entry.en: Pick at least one book entry to match this line to.

acct.recon_reason_reversal.en: The bank reversed this within 3 days, so neither line needs an entry.

acct.recon_reason_match.en: A book entry of the same amount on {date}.

acct.recon_reason_combo.en: Book entries of one counterparty add up to this amount. Check them before matching.

acct.recon_reason_document.en: {ref} is open for the same amount.

acct.recon_reason_transfer.en: A line of the same amount on another of your accounts on {date}.

acct.recon_reason_slip.en: A receipt dated {date} for the same amount.

acct.recon_reason_no_vat.en: No tax invoice attached: no VAT claimed.

acct.recon_reason_question.en: Nothing in your books explains this line yet. Answer it, or ask your client.

acct.recon_duplicate_of.en: Already imported with the statement of {date}

acct.err_reading_not_finished.en: The statement is still being read. Wait for it to finish, then open the preview again.

acct.err_import_needs_bank.en: Choose the bank account for this statement, or add a new one.

acct.err_import_statement_count.en: The statements sent don't match the files that were read. Open the preview again.

acct.err_column_missing.en: The file has no column named {column}. Choose a column from the file.

acct.recon_book_before.en: Book balance before {date} is {book}, statement opens at {opening}

acct.err_amount_zero.en: The amount can't be zero. Enter the amount that moved.

acct.err_amount_minor_unit.en: This amount has more decimal places than {currency} allows. Round it to the smallest unit of {currency}.

acct.err_recon_match_total.en: The entries you picked add up to {total}, but the statement lines add up to {amount}. Pick entries that add up to the lines.

acct.err_transfer_same_bank.en: A transfer needs two different bank accounts. Pick another account to move the money to.

acct.err_recon_one_line.en: This answer works on one statement line at a time. Select a single line and try again.

acct.err_suspense_unmapped.en: Celerp can't add a Suspense account to this chart on its own. Choose the account for the {role} role in Posting accounts, then try again.

acct.err_recon_remember_kind.en: Only an answer that posts to an account can be remembered. Untick Remember, or post the line to an account.

acct.err_recon_no_cash_account.en: There is no cash account to move this withdrawal into. Add a bank account of the Cash type, then try again.

acct.err_recon_transfer_needs_bank.en: Pick the bank account the money moved to or from.

acct.err_recon_pay_needs_doc.en: Pick at least one open invoice or bill this line pays.

acct.err_recon_doc_direction.en: A deposit can only pay an invoice, and a withdrawal can only pay a bill. Pick a document that matches the line.

acct.err_recon_needs_account.en: Pick the account this line posts to.

acct.err_rule_sparse_amount.en: A rule on a general description like this one needs an amount too, or it would catch every line with that description. Add the amount.

acct.recon_suggested.en: Suggested an answer for {count} lines. Nothing is posted until you accept it.

acct.recon_model_not_run.en: The AI could not run, so {count} lines with no other evidence are left as questions. Check your AI credits, then suggest again.

acct.err_recon_delete_settled.en: This statement has lines that are already posted or matched. Undo those lines first, then remove the statement.

acct.err_recon_not_suspense.en: Only a line sitting in Suspense can be moved to another account.

reconciliation.no_client_user.en: No one in this company answers bank questions yet. Invite your client at /settings/users with a role that can answer questions about bank lines, then ask again.

reconciliation.question_settled.en: Your accountant has already settled this line, so it needs no answer now.

reconciliation.receipt_not_saved.en: The receipt could not be saved. Your answer was not saved; try again.

acct.recon_questions_body.en: Your accountant has {count} open questions about your bank lines.

acct.recon_questions_reminder.en: Reminder {n}: your accountant still has {count} open questions about your bank lines.

acct.recon_questions_where.en: Sign in to Celerp and open Questions from your accountant to answer them.

acct.recon_asked.en: Asked about {count} lines. {names} can answer them in Celerp and got an email.

acct.recon_asked_email_failed.en: Asked about {count} lines. The email to {name} could not be sent: {reason}. They see the questions when they sign in; Remind sends it again.

acct.recon_asked_email_unconfirmed.en: Asked about {count} lines. The email to {name} may have gone out, but it was not confirmed. They see the questions when they sign in.

ai.warn_credits.en: This reads {count} files with AI credits.

ai.warn_credits_one.en: This reads 1 file with AI credits.

acct.recon_block_currency.en: This statement is in {currency}; the bank account is in {bank_currency}.

acct.recon_block_no_amount.en: Line {n} has no amount that can be read.

acct.recon_block_outside_period.en: Line {n} ({date}) is outside the statement period.

acct.recon_block_tie_break.en: The running balance stops adding up at line {n}.

acct.recon_block_tie_out.en: Opening balance plus the lines does not equal the closing balance.

acct.recon_block_balances_missing.en: Enter the opening and closing balance from the statement.

ai.err_file_not_found.en: Celerp couldn't find this file. It may have been removed. Upload it again.

bank.list_intro.en: Open a bank to see its statement lines, or drop a new statement on its page.

bank.page_intro.en: Each line from this bank's statements, grouped by who the money went to or came from. Tick the groups whose suggestion is right and post them, or answer a line on its own.

bank.view_empty.en: No lines in this view. Try another view or clear the search.

bank.in_suspense.en: {n} lines sit in Suspense until you say where they belong.

bank.complete_confirm.en: Complete each open statement that balances, oldest first?

bank.post_ticked_confirm.en: Post the ticked lines with their suggestions?

bank.nothing_ticked.en: Tick the groups or lines to post first.

bank.undo_confirm.en: Undo this line? What it posted is voided and the line is open again.

bank.undo_all_confirm.en: Undo these {n} lines? What they posted is voided and the lines are open again.

bank.err_choose_answer.en: Choose an answer for this line first.

bank.split_hint.en: Split the line across accounts. The parts must add up to the line's amount.

bank.drop_hint.en: PDF, CSV, OFX or QFX. Celerp reads it and shows every line before anything is imported.

bank.preview_reading.en: Reading the statement. This takes a moment.

bank.preview_ties.en: The statement ties: the opening balance plus every line equals the closing balance.

bank.preview_not_tied.en: The statement does not tie yet. Check the opening and closing balances and the period.

bank.failed_steps.en: {n} pages could not be read. Import the rest, or drop those pages again.

bank.import_confirm.en: Import these statements onto this bank?

bank.questions_intro.en: Your accountant asked about these bank lines. Say what each one was and who it was paid to or from, and add a receipt if you have one.

bank.questions_empty.en: No questions are waiting. Thank you.

bank.answer_saved.en: Saved. Your accountant can see your answer now.

bank.write_off_confirm.en: Write off what is left of this statement's difference? Celerp posts a small adjustment to your general expense account.

bank.remove_statement_confirm.en: Remove this statement and its lines? You can drop the file again later. A statement with a posted line can't be removed until you undo that line.

bank.reopened.en: The statement is open again. Complete it again when you're done.

bank.statement_removed.en: The statement and its lines are removed.

bank.counted_entries.en: Book entries this statement counts without a statement line. Press Undo on any that should not count.

bank.entry_undone.en: The entry no longer counts on this statement.
